title: Application of Part.―This Part applies only to sea-going passenger ships fitted with
text:
219. Application of Part.―This Part applies only to sea-going passenger ships fitted with

mechanical means of propulsion, but the provisions of this Part relating to [special trade passenger
ships] shall not apply ―

(a) to any such ship not carrying more than thirty [special trade passengers]; or

(b) to any such ship not intended to carry [special trade passengers] to or from any port or

place in India.
